rules.title: San Diego: no noisy construction 7 p.m.-7 a.m., on Sundays or City legal holidays without a prior noise permit
rules.plain_english: In the City of San Diego you may not build, demolish, excavate, alter or repair a building between 7 p.m. and 7 a.m. (any day), on Sundays, or on City legal holidays (except Columbus Day and Washington's Birthday) in a way that makes disturbing, excessive or offensive noise, unless you applied for and received a permit from the Noise Abatement Administrator before the work.

verification_meta.method: Independent re-verification of all 130 rules. Every source_location on a reachable host (www.sandiego.gov, dbs.lacity.gov) was fetched fresh on 2026-11-25 (all 33 source URLs on those hosts, plus the 2026-04 IB 177 PDF, the 2017 LADBS HCR notice and three 2024-2025 project noise reports posted on sandiego.gov; HTML converted to text with BeautifulSoup, PDFs with pdftotext). Every verbatim_quote was string-matched against the fetched text after whitespace, quote-mark and dash normalization, and every parameter value, threshold, date, citation and applies_to scope was compared by hand with the official text. The LADBS Good Neighbor sheet has a fragmented text layer, so it was rendered to an image with pdftoppm and read visually. Statuses: confirmed = the official source in source_location states the rule and every parameter. corrected = a parameter, scope or wording was changed to match the text; the change is recorded in verification.correction, and the rule now carries the corrected values. unverifiable = the primary text could not be read: the host is blocked by the session network policy or bot protection, which was not bypassed. refuted = contradicted by or absent from the source; none were. Hosts were re-tested in this session, not taken from the producer's notes.
